Build.description: The artifact one build of an `App` published, as the build lane writes it back (AP-13a).

builtAt.description: When the build lane published it.

commit.description: The commit of the source the artifact was built from, 7 to 40 lowercase hexadecimal characters.

component.description: The digest of a `wasm` App's server component, taken from the checked bundle and stored by it in the object store; what the WASM host loads and checks (AP-151).

digest.description: The artifact's digest, `sha256:` and 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. The reconciler deploys this and nothing else (AP-72).

sdkVersion.description: The version of the app SDK the artifact was built against.

capture.description: How much a `capture` broker keeps; read only in that mode.

limits.description: Per-client and per-broker limits, each within the platform ceiling.

mode.description: What the broker does with a message; absent is `ingest` (ADR-N-048 §2.10).

port.description: A dedicated port from 18830–18849 instead of TLS by SNI on 8883.

roles.description: Who may connect and to which topics; at least one role.

messagesPerTopic.description: Messages kept per topic, newest first.

window.description: How long a message is kept from its arrival, an ISO 8601 duration `PT…`.

maxConnections.description: Connections the broker holds at once.

messagesPerSecond.description: Messages one client may publish per second.

MqttMode.description: What a broker does with a message (ADR-N-048 §2.10).

oneOf.description: Devices publish and nothing else; the project's pipelines are the only subscribers.
`ingest`, and the Portal keeps the newest messages for the project's stewards.
Devices may also subscribe, each under its own `${clientid}`.

MqttRole.description: A role: the ServiceAccounts that hold it and the topic filters it grants.

name.description: A DNS label, unique among the broker's roles.

publish.description: Topic filters the role may publish to; `${clientid}` is the connecting client.

serviceAccounts.description: ServiceAccounts of the broker's own project, by name.

subscribe.description: Topic filters the role may subscribe to, each under the client's own `${clientid}`.

MultiLanguageMap.description: Multi-language map keyed by ISO 639-1 two-letter lowercase language codes

ObjectMeta.description: Metadata envelope attached to every platform resource (MF-02).

annotations.description: Key-value annotations for provenance and ownership (MF-08).

description.description: Human-readable description: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

title.description: Human-readable title: one string, or the legacy map per locale (UI-50, PF-24).

oneOf.description: Resource manifest is in draft state.
Resource is pending review or approval.
Resource is live and active in cluster.

The platform holds something the repository does not declare, or no longer holds what it does (CC-21, UI-25). Configuration cannot reach this phase — every component reads it from the repository (CC-72) — so it is a space whose seed entities the broker answers differently, and the two resolutions of UI-26 are what a person does about it.

Status.description: Server-computed lifecycle and reconciliation status (MF-04). Never stored in Git.

build.description: What the build lane published for an `App`, and the only place its artifact is named (AP-13a). Written back by the build lane in the commit that publishes the artifact; an App without it renders no pod, and no other principal may set it (AP-73).

observedRevision.description: Git commit revision observed during reconciliation.

shard.description: The shard of the WASM host a `wasm` App runs on, recorded at its first publish and kept; the edge's route to the App's server is rendered from it (AP-149).

anyOf.description: The form every new manifest writes.

Text.description: A human label or description (UI-50): one plain string in the author's language. The legacy language map is still read, through release `v0.9`, and resolves to one string.

apiVersion.description: API version: [`API_VERSION`], or a version [`serves`] accepts for this kind.

metadata.description: Metadata identifying and labeling the resource.

status.description: Server-computed status. Stripped during export and serialization.
